params.body:
A member of gentells.com (role `guest`, a plan that opens the Observatory) may browse the reading screens and use Ask, and nothing else. This holds it on the server.

## What changes

- **No Standard for a guest.** `/standard` and everything under it (versions, proposals) are off the guest allowlist. A guest still gets `/taxonomy`, the labels every screen draws with.
- **Ask for a guest, on its own terms.** `POST /chat` and the guest's own conversations (list, open, forget) pass the gate (`isGuestAsk`); no other write does. For a guest the model:
  - answers from a context without the source counts or lapsed insights;
  - has three read-only tools (cohorts, signals, query on the guest's collections), served by the MCP server in guest mode, every answer through the report redaction. A report's passage is neither shown nor searched;
  - runs with `--tools ""` (no Read, no WebFetch, no WebSearch), `--strict-mcp-config`, in an empty directory outside the repository (no CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in its context), on the default model;
  - writes nothing: the guest tools record no trail.
- **A daily number.** 20 questions per 24 hours per member (`ASK_GUEST_DAILY`). At the limit the answer is a 429 that says when Ask opens again. A question that got no answer does not count. Every question, the team's included, is logged per account in `ask_usage`.
- The guest's response guard passes Ask's event stream on as it comes, so the answer streams.
- `docs/design/one-account.md` updated.

## How it is proven

- `test/guest-writes.test.mjs` reads every route the server defines (paths, prefixes, patterns), starts the real server, and sends each one POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE with a guest token. Each answers 403, or is Ask, or carries its own credential (login, signed links, Elixir, projection, control) and answers the guest exactly as it answers a stranger. A new pre-gate route that treats a guest differently fails by name. The same sweep checks every read: only the guest screens' reads, Ask and `/auth/verify` answer.
- `test/guest-ask.test.mjs` runs `/chat` with a stand-in `claude` on PATH and checks the flags, working directory, model and context a guest's question gets, the cap and the usage log. It also drives the MCP server in guest mode over stdio.
- 16 mutations of the guards (guest guard removed, Standard back, Ask widened, a new pre-gate write route, built-in tools back, other MCP servers, cwd in the repo, passage search, trail write, all tools, no redaction, no cap, model choice, sources in context, failed questions counted) each turn a test red.
- Full suite 1372/1378. The 6 failures are `report-render` (no `pdftoppm` on the machine that ran it). `tsc` clean.
- Tried with the real CLI on a local stack, signed in through the OAuth hand-off as a member on Intelligence. Asked to read `.env`, fetch a URL and name its tools, the model said it had no file or web access and named the three guest tools.

Goes with gentells-dashboard `workbench/member-access` (Ask in the panel for a guest) and gentells-studio `workbench/member-access`. Merge this one first.
params.title: A gentells.com member browses and asks, and writes nothing
